task: Parse an AWS S3 bucket name from an S3 URI string (e.g., 's3://my-bucket-name/path/to/object')
solution_criteria: Regex must correctly extract bucket name from valid S3 URIs and handle URIs with or without object paths

task: Create a JSON object representing an AWS IAM policy that allows read-only access to a specific S3 bucket
solution_criteria: JSON must include valid Structure with Version, Statement, Effect set to Allow, Action limited to s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket, and Resource restricted to the specified bucket ARN

task: Write a Python function that converts an AWS CloudWatch log timestamp (Unix milliseconds) to a human-readable ISO 8601 format string
solution_criteria: Function must correctly convert Unix milliseconds to ISO 8601 format, handle edge cases like zero/negative timestamps, and return a properly formatted datetime string
